about: What the figure's animation must get right through its transitions, a row a criterion (tools/anim/README.md, D631): what a player notices, its bar and source, measured by the animation course (terra_walker figure::course: the man's figure posed headless by the game's own clips, blends, sync groups, stride warping, foot lock and lift, driven as the mover moves him). `noticed` is how much a player notices it, 5 most; the scorecard ranks failing rows by it, then by how many bars out (its `next` line, the task list). A pop is a joint's change of angular velocity in a frame over the worst its clips do alone at full weight (floored at 60 deg/s), so 1 is as rough as the clips themselves; a slide a ball moving while its clips have it planted (their baked lock curve at 1) and it stands within 2 cm of its standing height; a glide the body's speed against the speed its leg clips stride at (pace x rate x warp, weighted).

criteria.notice: a limb snaps going into or out of a fight move from the guard (the roll's arm at its first frame)
criteria.source: Bollo, 'Inertialization: High-Performance Animation Transitions in Gears of War' (GDC 2018); UE5's Inertialization node: a transition adds no change of velocity the clips lack

criteria.notice: a foot skates along the ground in a steady jog or sprint (the Sprint_Loop skate, char-faults j3), over a whole 3 s stretch, not only a transition's window
criteria.source: tools/controller feet.sliding's bar (2 cm), D455's foot lock

criteria.notice: a stop's legs go on striding after the body has stood (the loop fading over 180 ms while the body stops in 0.15-0.2 s)
criteria.source: Lyra's distance-matched stops (UE5 Animation Locomotion Library, DistanceMatchToTarget); Paragon's planted-foot stops

criteria.notice: a start's feet stride slower or faster than the body sets off (the loop at once, where a start clip would match its root's travel to the body's)
criteria.source: Lyra's distance-matched starts (AdvanceTimeByDistanceMatching, play rate clamped 0.6-5)

criteria.notice: a limb snaps at a jump's take-off or landing (Jump_Loop cut in once airborne)
the head or a limb snaps as a jog or sprint stops
a foot skates in a fight move (the roll's)
a limb snaps as the body sets off into a jog or sprint
a loop jerks where it wraps (Sprint_Loop's arm)
criteria.source: ours: a loop's last frame runs into its first as any frame into the next

criteria.notice: a steady jog's or sprint's feet stride at another speed than the body goes (stride warping's leftover)
criteria.source: UE5 Stride Warping (Animation Warping plugin); tools/controller pace.match

criteria.notice: between jog and sprint the feet stride at another speed than the body goes
criteria.source: UE5 sync groups and stride warping

criteria.notice: a limb snaps between jog and sprint
a limb snaps as the body turns moving or in place
the feet go on shuffling after the body has stood
criteria.source: Paragon's and Lyra's stops: a stop clip ends planted; tools/controller stop.settle

criteria.notice: the feet stride at another speed than the body goes through a turn
the feet stride at another speed than the body goes on a jump's ground frames
a foot skates as the body sets off
a foot skates as the body stops
a foot skates between jog and sprint
a foot skates through a turn
a foot skates at a jump's take-off or landing
a stop's feet end apart from the idle's own stance
criteria.source: ours: a stop ends in the idle's stance
